Condition : 2 - Reason for approval:

The proposed extensions for changing rooms and enlargements of the function hall. through their small scale ancillary nature, would not have an adverse affect upon the living conditions of residents, highway safety or the chracter and appearance of the open space or adjoining Conservation Area. This development is therefore considered to be in accordance with policies ENV.N.1.11 Protection and Improvement of Local Open Space), C.5.1 (New Leisure Development) and T.1.4 (Car, cycle and parking and servicing facilities of Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 6 - The portable buildings shown with a dotted line on drawing 545A/RDP/PO1-1, shall be permanently removed from the site prior to occupation of the development

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until full details of soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the clubhouse shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 9 - The proposed glazing/cladding to the south west elevation shall be constrcuted of non-reflective materials unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Removal of an existing staircase from west elevation, and erection of single storey side extension to replace existing toilets and changing facilities in temporary structures and erection of single storey extension to south face to create further accommodation to existing function hall to existing building.
